acf.product_notice_title: Ireland IIP: what remains open after the 2023 closure

product_notice_bullets.product_notice_bullet_text: Ireland's Immigrant Investor Programme (IIP) stopped accepting new applications on February 15, 2023
Legally eligible endowment projects may still accept investment allocations to complete their fundraising

IMM Group — the first firm to process Ireland applications in Vietnam, beginning in 2017, and the exclusive partner of the Eterna investment fund — currently holds a limited number of eligible endowment allocations
Once you naturalize as an Irish citizen, you are eligible to live and work across the EU and, under the Common Travel Area, in the UK — subject to the applicable rules

product_hero_content.product_hero_content_title: Ireland golden visa: Stamp 4 residency through the Immigrant Investor Programme (IIP)

product_hero_content_text.product_hero_content_text_item: The Irish government's Immigrant Investor Programme (IIP), widely known as the Ireland golden visa, granted Stamp 4 residency to non-EU investors and their families. It closed to new applications on February 15, 2023. A limited number of €400,000 endowment allocations remain available through legally eligible projects.
Live, study, and work entirely in English inside the EU
Once you naturalize as an Irish citizen, you are eligible to live across all 27 EU member states and, under the Common Travel Area, in the UK

product_benefits_item_bullets.product_benefits_item_bullet_text: The main applicant, spouse, and children under 24
Live, study, and work under Stamp 4 conditions
Free tuition for your children through the end of secondary school
One of Europe's leading education systems, taught entirely in English — opening paths to leading universities in the UK, the US, and the EU

Exemption from the English language requirement when applying for UK settlement and citizenship

acf.product_advantages_title: What made the Ireland Immigrant Investor Programme (IIP) attractive

product_advantages_item_bullets.product_advantages_item_bullet_text: One of the few programs structured this way
This reduces the risk to both your investment and your Stamp 4 residency
Just 1 day per year to maintain Stamp 4
Note: this applies only to maintaining IIP residency — it is not the requirement for citizenship
Expected processing times depend on the individual application and on the workload at Immigration Service Delivery (ISD).

product_conditions_item_bullets.product_conditions_item_bullet_text: Aged 18 or older, with no upper age limit
Meets security and background vetting requirements
Children under 24 who are unmarried, in full-time education, and financially dependent
Meets security and background vetting requirements
Evidence that the investment capital comes from a lawful source.
Option 1: Invest €1 million (approximately US$1.15 million) in a qualifying enterprise or project, and hold the investment for 3 years.
Option 2: Make an endowment of €400,000 (approximately US$459,000) to a social project in the arts, culture, sport or education.

product_conditions_items.product_conditions_item_footnote: Please note: the Ireland IIP stopped accepting new applications on February 15, 2023. IMM Group holds a limited number of eligible endowment places from projects that met the legal criteria before that date.

acf.product_process_title: Ireland golden visa process, step by step

product_process_steps.product_process_step_desc: Sign the deposit agreement and complete the initial due diligence on your file.
Complete the IMM Group service agreement together with the contracts that establish and implement the investment.
Prepare the legal documentation and file your application for Irish residency under the Immigrant Investor Programme (IIP).
The Irish government reviews the application and issues pre-approval.
Transfer the investment capital once the application has received pre-approval.

product_process_steps.product_process_step_title: Travel to Ireland to complete the formalities
product_process_steps.product_process_step_desc: Travel to Ireland to complete the remaining formalities and provide your fingerprints. You receive your residence permit (Stamp 4) during the same trip.

product_faq_items.product_faq_item_question: Can you buy real estate to get Irish residency?

product_faq_item_sections.product_faq_item_section_heading: No — the Ireland IIP has no real estate purchase option.

product_faq_item_section_bullets.product_faq_item_section_bullet_text: An endowment of €400,000 to a social project
An investment of €1 million in an enterprise — held for 3 years

product_faq_items.product_faq_item_question: Which option do most investors choose?

product_faq_item_section_bullets.product_faq_item_section_bullet_text: In practice, most of our clients have chosen the endowment option
IMM Group was the first firm to process Ireland applications in Vietnam (since 2017).

product_faq_item_sections.product_faq_item_section_heading: Three reasons clients choose the endowment option

product_faq_item_section_bullets.product_faq_item_section_bullet_text: Lowest cost — €400,000
Simpler process — no need to maintain the investment for 3 years
Aligns with the timeline for children to relocate and study with free tuition

product_faq_items.product_faq_item_question: What is a Stamp 4 visa in Ireland?

product_faq_item_sections.product_faq_item_section_heading: Stamp 4 — long-term residence status under the IIP

product_faq_item_section_bullets.product_faq_item_section_bullet_text: Stamp 4 is a form of residence permission (not a visa); the physical card is the Irish Residence Permit (IRP)
Issued after the application is approved by ISD in Ireland — processing time depends on ISD schedules
Allows you to live, work, do business, and study in Ireland under Stamp 4 conditions
Has a fixed validity period and must be renewed as required
Once you meet the reckonable residence requirements, you may apply for naturalization

product_faq_items.product_faq_item_question: Does Stamp 4 allow free travel in the Schengen Area and the EU?

product_faq_item_section_bullets.product_faq_item_section_bullet_text: Stamp 4 does not yet provide visa-free access to the Schengen Area
Travel to the Schengen Area still requires a travel visa
Holding Irish residence status may make the Schengen visa process more straightforward
After naturalizing as an Irish citizen: eligible to travel, live, work, and study in EU countries, subject to the applicable rules.

product_faq_items.product_faq_item_question: What is the difference between the Schengen Area and the EU?

product_faq_item_sections.product_faq_item_section_heading: The Schengen Area is not the same thing as the EU

product_faq_item_section_bullets.product_faq_item_section_bullet_text: EU — the European Union: 27 countries, an intergovernmental organization
Schengen: currently 29 countries that allow free movement
Ireland is an EU member but is not part of the Schengen Area
Stamp 4 holders still need a Schengen visa for travel.

product_faq_items.product_faq_item_question: Can your children study in other EU countries?

product_faq_item_section_bullets.product_faq_item_section_bullet_text: No — with Stamp 4, children may only study in Ireland
To study in another EU country: a student visa is required
To study freely across the EU: Irish citizenship is required (once you are eligible)

product_faq_items.product_faq_item_question: Do you pay Irish tax on income earned outside Ireland?

product_faq_item_section_bullets.product_faq_item_section_bullet_text: Tax obligations depend on tax residency and the source of the income
Under Irish rules, an individual is treated as a tax resident once they are present for the required time thresholds (generally more than 183 days per year, or under a cumulative formula)
Short stays in Ireland (for example, 1 day per year) generally do not meet the tax residency thresholds
We recommend consulting an independent tax advisor before proceeding

product_faq_items.product_faq_item_question: Stamp 4 validity and renewal

product_faq_item_section_bullets.product_faq_item_section_bullet_text: First issued for: 2 years
First renewal: an additional 3 years
Subsequent renewals: 5 years each
Enterprise investment option: maintain the investment as required
Endowment option: file a renewal application in line with ISD requirements

product_faq_items.product_faq_item_question: Can you withdraw the investment after 3 years?

product_faq_item_section_bullets.product_faq_item_section_bullet_text: You may withdraw the capital after 3 years — on its own, this does not affect your renewal, provided the other conditions are met
The only requirement is to maintain the investment for 3 years
Governed by the rules of Immigration Service Delivery (ISD) in Ireland
Renewal conditions after 3 years
Meet the residence requirement of 1 day per year
No breaches of the law inside or outside Ireland

product_faq_items.product_faq_item_question: How long until you can apply for Irish citizenship?

product_faq_item_sections.product_faq_item_section_heading: You may apply for naturalization once you meet the reckonable residence requirements (a minimum of approximately 5 years under the rules)

product_faq_item_section_bullets.product_faq_item_section_bullet_text: You can meet the residence requirement in 1 of 2 ways:
Absences from Ireland of no more than 6 weeks per year during the first 4 years
Continuous residence for the 12 months of year 5, immediately before you apply

product_faq_item_sections.product_faq_item_section_heading: Option 2 — cumulative residence within a 9-year window

product_faq_item_section_bullets.product_faq_item_section_bullet_text: For example, applying in year 8: accumulate a total of 4 years within the first 6 years
Continuous residence for 12 months in year 7

product_faq_item_sections.product_faq_item_section_note: Note: the outcome of a naturalization application depends on approval by the competent Irish authorities

product_faq_items.product_faq_item_question: What does Irish citizenship give you?

product_faq_item_sections.product_faq_item_section_heading: Benefits after naturalizing as an Irish citizen

product_faq_item_section_bullets.product_faq_item_section_bullet_text: Full rights of an Irish citizen under Irish law
Eligible to live in the 27 EU member states
Eligible to live, study, and work in the UK through the Common Travel Area (CTA), subject to the applicable rules
Eligible to apply for British citizenship once the UK residence conditions are met — with an exemption from the English language test
The Irish passport ranks among the world's strongest — supporting visa-free or eVisa travel to many countries

product_faq_items.product_faq_item_question: Do I have to pass an Irish language test to obtain citizenship?

product_faq_item_section_bullets.product_faq_item_section_bullet_text: No language test is required — not even in English
You only need to meet the residence conditions and file the application
This differs from Portugal and Greece, which require a test in the national language

product_faq_items.product_faq_item_question: What are the conditions for British citizenship once I hold Irish citizenship?

product_faq_item_section_bullets.product_faq_item_section_bullet_text: Aged over 18
5 years of residence in the UK before the date of application
Indefinite Leave to Remain (ILR) for the final 12 months
English at B1 level (Irish citizens are exempt)
Passing the Life in the UK test
Demonstrating an intention to live in the UK long term
Meets security and background vetting requirements

product_faq_item_sections.product_faq_item_section_heading: Note on time spent outside the UK

product_faq_item_section_bullets.product_faq_item_section_bullet_text: No more than 450 days outside the UK over the 5 years
No more than 90 days outside the UK in the final 12 months

product_faq_items.product_faq_item_question: Can I hold 3 citizenships — Irish, British, and my existing nationality?

product_faq_item_section_bullets.product_faq_item_section_bullet_text: You may hold more than one citizenship — this must be assessed under the nationality law of your home country
Ireland and the UK both allow dual or multiple citizenship
For your home country: holding an additional foreign citizenship must be assessed under your home country's nationality law — we recommend consulting an independent legal advisor

product_faq_items.product_faq_item_question: Do I need British citizenship if I already have Irish citizenship?

product_faq_item_section_bullets.product_faq_item_section_bullet_text: Not necessarily — Irish citizenship already opens the right to live in the UK
Irish citizenship allows you to live in the UK under the Common Travel Area (CTA)
Under the CTA, Irish citizens are not treated as "foreign nationals" in the UK
If you still wish to naturalize as a British citizen, you are exempt from the language test.

product_faq_items.product_faq_item_question: What are the investment risks?

product_faq_item_sections.product_faq_item_section_heading: Three main risks of the Ireland Immigrant Investor Programme (IIP)

product_faq_item_section_bullets.product_faq_item_section_bullet_text: Enterprise investment option: choosing an unreliable project or developer, or a project that is not viable
Both options: an unclear source of funds leading to refusal of the application
An attorney or immigration firm without experience in proving the source of funds

product_faq_items.product_faq_item_question: Is the Ireland program stable?

product_faq_item_sections.product_faq_item_section_heading: The program has a long operating track record in Europe, although it no longer accepts new applications

product_faq_item_section_bullets.product_faq_item_section_bullet_text: One of the EU's first residency-by-investment programs, alongside Portugal
Launched in the aftermath of the 2007–2008 financial crisis
Well regarded in the region for its maturity and transparency
Processing times depend on ISD schedules in Ireland

product_faq_items.product_faq_item_question: Who can be included in the application?

product_faq_item_sections.product_faq_item_section_heading: Family members who can be included in the application

product_faq_item_section_bullets.product_faq_item_section_bullet_text: Your legal spouse
Children under 24 who are unmarried, in full-time education, and financially dependent
The dependent-child policy is relatively generous compared with many other programs.

product_faq_items.product_faq_item_question: Is dependency straightforward to prove?

product_faq_item_section_bullets.product_faq_item_section_bullet_text: Only your children's birth certificates are needed
Children under 18: no proof of dependency required
Children aged 18–24: evidence that they are still in education and financially dependent

product_faq_items.product_faq_item_question: Are adopted children and stepchildren eligible?

product_faq_item_sections.product_faq_item_section_heading: Adopted children and stepchildren are eligible

product_faq_item_section_bullets.product_faq_item_section_bullet_text: Adopted child: a legal certificate is required
Stepchild: a legal certificate plus a notarized letter of consent from the spouse
IMM Group assists with preparing the documents.

product_faq_items.product_faq_item_question: Can parents be included in the application?

product_faq_item_section_bullets.product_faq_item_section_bullet_text: No — the program does not accept parents within the same application
An application covers only the main applicant, the spouse, and dependent children
IMM Group assists with visitor visa applications for parents
Alternatives if you want to bring the whole family
Move to the Portugal Golden Visa
File a separate Ireland application for the parents

product_faq_items.product_faq_item_question: Is there a language requirement?

product_faq_item_section_bullets.product_faq_item_section_bullet_text: No language requirement — and no age or management experience requirement
Basic conditions
Personal net worth of at least €2 million from a lawful source
Choose 1 of the 2 investment options
Cash requirement by option
Endowment option: €400,000 held as cash or in a savings account
Enterprise investment option: €1 million in cash ready to invest

product_faq_items.product_faq_item_question: Is there an annual application quota?

product_faq_item_section_bullets.product_faq_item_section_bullet_text: Note: the Ireland IIP stopped accepting new applications on February 15, 2023
Previously, the program opened application windows according to the ISD calendar during the year
Only investment places in projects that were legally eligible before that date are still being accepted, in order to complete their target funding

product_faq_items.product_faq_item_question: How many days a year do I have to spend in Ireland?

product_faq_item_section_bullets.product_faq_item_section_bullet_text: Just 1 day per year to maintain Stamp 4
Note: this applies only to maintaining IIP residency — it is not the requirement for citizenship
Tip: travel to Ireland late in 1 year and stay into the next — a single trip can cover the requirement for 2 years.
